description: ML Pipeline: replace preference_dataset.py, create embedding_fetcher.py (FIX-1/FIX-4), create rlhf_policy_model.py with proper PPO+clipping (FIX-2), and create train_rlhf.py training script. Depends on FEAT-001 (RLHFFeedback model).
steps: Replace backend/app/ml/preference_dataset.py entirely. New implementation: import RLHFFeedback (new model, not RecommendationFeedback). Function build_preference_pairs(db, user_id, min_pairs=100, time_window_days=90, embedding_coverage_threshold=0.7) -> tuple[list[tuple[str,str,float]], dict]: (1) fetch all RLHFFeedback rows for user in time window, (2) keep only latest per outfit_id (sort by created_at DESC, deduplicate), (3) for each remaining outfit call vector_store.fetch_embeddings(item_ids_str) — FIX-1: never zero-pad — count valid embeddings, if coverage < 0.7 log warning and skip outfit (FIX-4), (4) build pairs (outfit_a_id, outfit_b_id, weight=(rating_a-rating_b)/4.0) for all a,b where rating_a > rating_b, (5) return (pairs, metadata) where metadata includes pair_count, feedback_count, filtered_outfits count, ready_for_training bool. Preserve old function signature for backward compat: keep the old build_preference_pairs(db, user_id, vector_store) signature as a deprecated wrapper that calls the new one.

Create backend/app/ml/embedding_fetcher.py: function get_outfit_embeddings(db, outfit_ids: list[str]) -> tuple[dict[str, np.ndarray], dict]: for each outfit_id fetch Outfit ORM object from DB, get item_ids, call vector_store.fetch_embeddings(item_ids_str) (FIX-1: never zero-pad missing items — skip with logger.warning), count valid embeddings, if coverage < 0.7 add to low_coverage list and skip (FIX-4), otherwise mean-pool valid embeddings to (512,) ndarray. Return {outfit_id: ndarray} dict and metadata {total_outfits, valid_outfits, failed_lookups: list[str], low_coverage: list[str]}. Function filter_pairs_by_embeddings(pairs: list[tuple[str,str,float]], embeddings: dict[str, np.ndarray]) -> tuple[list[tuple[str,np.ndarray,np.ndarray,float]], list[tuple]]: return (valid, dropped) where valid pairs have both embeddings, dropped ones don't. Log count of dropped pairs at WARNING level.

Create backend/app/ml/rlhf_policy_model.py: guard with try/except torch import and _TORCH_AVAILABLE. Class RLHFPolicyModel(nn.Module): 512→256→128→1 MLP, no final activation, _trained: bool. Implement function train_policy_ppo(policy_model, reward_model, pairs: list[tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, float]], epochs=3, lr=1e-5, eps=0.2, entropy_coef=0.01) — PROPER PPO WITH CLIPPING (FIX-2): (a) first pass collect old_log_probs with no_grad: old_log_prob_a = logsigmoid(policy_model(emb_a)).detach(), old_log_prob_b = logsigmoid(policy_model(emb_b)).detach(); (b) per epoch, for each pair compute reward_a=reward_model(emb_a).detach(), reward_b=reward_model(emb_b).detach(), baseline=(reward_a+reward_b)/2, advantage_a=(reward_a-baseline)*weight, advantage_b=-(reward_b-baseline)*weight; (c) recompute new_log_prob_a=logsigmoid(policy_model(emb_a)), ratio_a=exp(new_log_prob_a - old_log_prob_a.detach()); (d) ppo_loss_a = -min(ratio_a*advantage_a, clamp(ratio_a,1-eps,1+eps)*advantage_a); (e) entropy = -(sigmoid(policy_model(emb_a)) * logsigmoid(policy_model(emb_a)) + (1-sigmoid(policy_model(emb_a))) * log(1-sigmoid(policy_model(emb_a))+1e-8)); (f) loss = ppo_loss_a + ppo_loss_b - entropy_coef*entropy; optimizer.zero_grad(); loss.backward(); optimizer.step(). Set policy_model._trained=True. Return dict with epoch_losses and epoch_accuracies. Also implement load_policy_model(user_id: str) -> RLHFPolicyModel|None: loads artifacts/outfit_composition_rlhf_policy.pt with torch.load(..., weights_only=True) then load_state_dict(strict=False); returns None if file missing or load fails (log error). Implement save_policy_model(model, user_id: str): saves to artifacts/outfit_composition_rlhf_policy.pt (same path regardless of user_id — single global policy per instance). Stub class for _TORCH_AVAILABLE=False.

Create backend/train_rlhf.py: argparse CLI with --user-id (required), --min-pairs (100), --reward-epochs (20), --policy-epochs (3), --dry-run (flag). Pipeline: (1) SessionLocal() db, (2) build_preference_pairs → check ready_for_training, exit with status 'skipped_insufficient_data' if not, (3) get_outfit_embeddings for all outfit_ids in pairs, (4) filter_pairs_by_embeddings → check valid pairs >= min_pairs, (5) train reward model: preference_reward_model.load_or_init(user_id) + train_from_feedback(feedback_pairs, epochs=reward_epochs) + save(model, user_id) if not dry_run, (6) train policy: RLHFPolicyModel() + train_policy_ppo(policy_model, reward_model, policy_pairs, epochs=policy_epochs) + save_policy_model(policy_model, user_id) if not dry_run, (7) print JSON summary to stdout, (8) sys.exit(0) on success/skipped, sys.exit(1) on failure. sys.path.insert to make app importable from backend/.
acceptance_criteria: Running 'from app.ml.embedding_fetcher import get_outfit_embeddings, filter_pairs_by_embeddings' succeeds.
Running 'from app.ml.rlhf_policy_model import RLHFPolicyModel, train_policy_ppo, load_policy_model, save_policy_model' succeeds.
train_policy_ppo uses ratio = exp(new_log_prob - old_log_prob) and loss = -min(ratio*adv, clip(ratio,1-eps,1+eps)*adv) — verifiable by code inspection.
preference_dataset.build_preference_pairs skips outfits with <70% embedding coverage and logs a warning (FIX-4).
embedding_fetcher.get_outfit_embeddings never inserts zero vectors — items missing from fetch_embeddings result are simply skipped (FIX-1).
Running 'cd backend && python train_rlhf.py --user-id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 --dry-run' exits with code 0 or 1 (not crash/traceback), outputting JSON with a 'status' field.
Both old and new preference_dataset.py signatures are importable without error.
verification: cd backend && python -c "from app.ml.preference_dataset import build_preference_pairs; from app.ml.embedding_fetcher import get_outfit_embeddings, filter_pairs_by_embeddings; from app.ml.rlhf_policy_model import RLHFPolicyModel, train_policy_ppo; print('FEAT-003 imports OK')"
findings: PPO implementation: old_log_probs collected in a no-grad first pass before training loop; per epoch each pair recomputes new_log_probs, ratios = exp(new_lp - old_lp.detach()), clipped objectives, entropy bonus on p_a. Reward model frozen during policy training. FIX-1 honoured: fetch_embeddings missing items logged+skipped, zero vectors never created. FIX-4: outfits with <70% coverage logged at WARNING and excluded entirely; count reported. FIX-5: latest-per-outfit dedup via ORDER BY created_at DESC + seen-set. Backward compat: old build_preference_pairs(db, user_id, vector_store) call detected by positional vector_store arg and delegates to _legacy_build_preference_pairs which calls new implementation. train_rlhf.py exits 0 for skipped_insufficient_data (DB table missing or too few pairs) and exits 1 only on unhandled exceptions.
